title: Finding Verdict (external-review ruling)
description: The ruling assigned to a SINGLE review finding in the external-review pattern (whether it is a genuine defect and what to do). This is the FULL set the review-arbiter may emit. ADVOCATES emit only a 4-value SUBSET (REAL, FALSE_POSITIVE, ACCEPT_SUPPRESS, NEEDS_PRODUCT_DECISION) — they cannot rule ALREADY_RESOLVED or ESCALATE, which are arbiter-only calls. Distinct from the review-report-level verdict (see report-verdict.schema.json). The ruling SEMANTICS live in the review-arbiter agent + the standard-judging constitution.
